title: Strategies of Rendering Metaphor from Arabic into English: A Comparative Study of ChatGPT and Matecat
core_idea: Analyze how Arabic metaphors from Naguib Mahfouz's Zuqaq al-Midaq are rendered into English by a human translator versus two machine translation systems (ChatGPT-4 and Matecat), using Nida's formal and dynamic equivalence framework to identify translation strategies across 106 metaphors.
tldr: A comparative analysis of translation strategies for 106 Arabic metaphors from Zuqaq al-Midaq, contrasting a human translator with ChatGPT-4 and Matecat through Nida's formal/dynamic equivalence lens to determine predominant approaches.
